subject.title: [Feature] Enforce disk space quotas and workspace growth limits on agent sandbox execution

question: Which storage surfaces must a configured sandbox quota hard-limit, and should backends that cannot enforce the requested guarantee fail setup or provide only a warning?
rationale: Docker writable layers, bind-mounted workspaces, logs, SSH filesystems, and plugin backends have different enforcement mechanisms, so implementation requires an explicit security and product contract.

options.title: Capability-gated hard limits
options.body: Define covered storage surfaces and reject configurations when the selected backend cannot enforce the requested hard limit.

options.title: Workspace-only guarantee
options.body: Hard-limit only the agent workspace through host or remote filesystem quotas and document runtime-layer and log controls separately.

options.title: Best-effort monitoring
options.body: Expose usage thresholds and warnings without representing them as a hard sandbox boundary.

recommendation.title: Capability-gated hard limits
recommendation.body: Define covered storage surfaces and reject configurations when the selected backend cannot enforce the requested hard limit.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the explicit owner of the sandbox implementation and documentation where the security contract belongs.
